verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email-and-calendar service, so sharing availability or inserting bookable times into an email is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only lists a 'Calendar events and invitations' help-article title and community remarks about calendar syncing. Nothing documents sharing availability, booking pages, or inserting meeting slots into a message.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
